Name: Granny Eun's Alternate Portraits for RSV
Author: GrannyEun
Description:
This mod features a new look for [b]all RSV character portraits[/b], including their beach portraits! These portraits are a bit stylized and feature a semi-realistic look. This will be the start of a much larger project, I hope you enjoy!

6/11/2024 Portraiture is LIVE! This should make things so much easier for many of you, hopefully. This version obviously requires Portraiture, hence why I added it to the requirements. It does not require, PyTK Lite, however! Works awesome without it!

[b][u][font=Courier New]Required - Please Install First[/font][/u][/b]

[size=2]Click the link below to download Rafseazz's Ridgeside Village mod:[/size]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][size=2]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286
[/size]
[/url][size=2][size=2]Click the link below to download Portraiture:[/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999][size=2]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999
[/size][/url]
[/size][font=Arial][size=2]Click the link below to download PyTK:
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726][b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726[/b][/url][/size][/font][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Courier New][b][u]
How to Install:﻿[/u][/b][/font]
[b]
[/b][b]Portraiture Version (Recommended):[/b]

Navigate to your "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" folder. Drag and drop the "GrannyEun" folder into the Portraits folder. Launch your game using SMAPI. When in a dialogue conversation, press the "p" button to change the portrait.
[b]
Replacement Version:[/b]

Drag and drop the folders [b][CP] Ridgeside Village[/b] into [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\Ridgeside Village [/i]to overwrite the original [b][CP] Ridgeside Village[/b] folder.

I recommend using PyTK Lite, I have not tested this mod with the original PyTK. 
[b]
[/b][b]***All characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]***

[/b]The mod used in my banner is herbivoor's Custom Menu Background: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7416

[/url]Visual mods used in my screenshots:
DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255[/url]
Gweniaczek's Medieval Buildings [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6086[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332[/url]
Stardew Valley Expanded [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753﻿]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753
[/url]﻿DustBeauty's Rustic Country Town Interiors [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5857[/url] and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4870]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4870[/url][font=Arial][i]

Thank you so much for installing my portrait mod! Be sure to tell me what you think, I am eager to hear from the community! ^^[/i][/font]
